<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subrogation" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subrogation">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ForwardCase" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subrogation">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Subrogation"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ForwardCase" name="Forward case" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subrogation" name="Subrogation recourse handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Subrogation" name="Possible subrogation identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_StartToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check subrogation case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_StartToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CheckToPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CheckToPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecourse" name="Case closed without recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RequestToReminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RequestToReminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReminderToEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitResponse" name="Await insurant response or deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReminderToEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToDisagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToDeadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BookPayment" name="Book payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterPayment" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentReceived" name="Case closed after payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDisagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning of disagreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Insurant reasoning correct?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAccepted" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DisagreementAccepted" name="Case closed, disagreement accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached without payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDeadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardMerge" name="Forward to collection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardToAgency" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StartToCheck" sourceRef="Start_Subrogation" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckToPossible" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RequestToReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReminderToEvent" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDisagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDeadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_PaymentToBooking" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BookingToClose" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment" targetRef="End_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DisagreementToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckReasoningToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAccepted" targetRef="End_DisagreementAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DeadlineToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_MergeToForward" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ForwardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterPayment" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentReceived" name="Case closed after payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDisagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning of disagreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Insurant reasoning correct?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAccepted" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DisagreementAccepted" name="Case closed, disagreement accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached without payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDeadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardMerge" name="Forward to collection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardToAgency" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Msg_ForwardCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StartToGetInfo" sourceRef="Start_Subrogation" targetRef="Task_GetInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_GetInfoToCheck" sourceRef="Task_GetInformation" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckToPossible" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RequestToReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReminderToEvent" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDisagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDeadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_PaymentToBooking" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BookingToClose" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment" targetRef="End_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DisagreementToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckReasoningToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAccepted" targetRef="End_DisagreementAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DeadlineToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_MergeToForward" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ForwardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subrogation" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subrogation">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subrogation">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Subrogation"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subrogation" name="Subrogation recourse handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Subrogation" name="Possible subrogation against insurant">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_StartToGetInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetInformation" name="Get information about possible subrogation">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_StartToGetInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_GetInfoToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check subrogation case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_GetInfoToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CheckToPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CheckToPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_NotPossible</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_Possible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_NotPossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecourse" name="Case closed without recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_Possible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RequestToReminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RequestToReminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReminderToEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitResponse" name="Await insurant response or disagreement deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReminderToEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToDisagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_EventToDeadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentReceived" messageRef="Msg_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BookPayment" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAfterPayment" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_BookingToClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentReceived" name="Case closed after payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDisagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning of disagreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DisagreementToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" name="Insurant reasoning correct?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CheckReasoningToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseAccepted" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DisagreementAccepted" name="Case closed, disagreement accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached without payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_EventToDeadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardMerge" name="Forward to collection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DeadlineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ForwardToAgency" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_MergeToForward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StartToGetInfo" sourceRef="Start_Subrogation" targetRef="Task_GetInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_GetInfoToCheck" sourceRef="Task_GetInformation" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckToPossible" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotPossible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Possible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseNoRecourseToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="End_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RequestToReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReminderToEvent" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDisagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_EventToDeadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Catch_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_PaymentToBooking" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BookingToClose" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAfterPaymentToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAfterPayment" targetRef="End_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DisagreementToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CheckReasoningToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Task_CloseAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCorrect" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CloseAcceptedToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseAccepted" targetRef="End_DisagreementAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DeadlineToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_MergeToForward" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ForwardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that after an awaited event occurs, two or more actions follow, joined by 'and' in one sentence: Model the awaited event as an intermediate catch event. Model each stated action as its own task, placed in sequence after that event in the order the description gives. Connect the last task to the outcome. Do not drop any stated action and do not fold one action into another task.
rules.situation: the description says that after an awaited event occurs, two or more actions follow, joined by 'and' in one sentence

rules.instruction: When the description says that after an awaited item is received (an event on a branch), the process performs one or more further named actions in sequence before a closing action: Model each described action that follows the receipt event as its own task, placed in the stated order between the receipt event and the closing task, connected by sequence flows. Do not drop such an action or merge it into the closing task or the event label.
rules.situation: the description says that after an awaited item is received (an event on a branch), the process performs one or more further named actions in sequence before a closing action

rules.instruction: When the description says that after a request is sent, the process waits for a reply and also for a stated deadline, and that when the deadline passes without the expected reply, a further step follows: Model the wait as an event-based gateway with one branch for the expected reply and one branch that starts with an intermediate timer catch event for the deadline. Connect the timer catch event to the step that the description says follows the deadline. Do not replace the timer wait with a task or leave the gateway branch without its catch event.
rules.situation: the description says that after a request is sent, the process waits for a reply and also for a stated deadline, and that when the deadline passes without the expected reply, a further step follows

rules.instruction: When the description says the process sends a request or case to an external party and then only waits for that party's outcome or a deadline, without describing any step the external party itself performs: Model the send as a task in the process's own pool, and model the awaited outcome as intermediate catch events or an event-based gateway in that same pool. Do not create a separate pool for the external party, and do not add message flows to or from it, unless the description states that the party performs process steps or communicates as an independent participant.
rules.situation: the description says the process sends a request or case to an external party and then only waits for that party's outcome or a deadline, without describing any step the external party itself performs
